d: The Kohinoor’s journey began in India, where it was mined from the legendary Kollur Mine in the Golconda region of present-day Andhra Pradesh. Once considered the largest known diamond in the world, it symbolized immense power. Over centuries, it passed through many rulers — Kakatiyas, Mughals, Persians, Afghans, and Sikhs. In 1849, after the British annexation of Punjab through the Treaty of Lahore, it was taken to London and added to the Crown Jewels under Queen Victoria.
